snippet.title: Harry Potter Actors Who Injured Their Co-Stars While Filming
snippet.description:
Filming can be dangerous business, especially when in the magical and mystical world of Harry Potter. Actors often wound up accidentally injuring each other while in the midst of intense action - never on purpose of course, but some of these accidents were rough! 
Helena Bonham Carter nearly caused Matthew Lewis to go deaf after getting a bit too friendly with a wand - she did end up drawing blood and perforating his eardrum! Emma Watson caused a fair amount of pain to a few of her male colleagues whether she was feeling feisty and in the moment or she was taking a co-stars request a little too seriously - either way, it was a rough day for those actors she hurt!  While we know Lucius Malfoy is generally evil, Jason Isaacs actually stabbed Tom Felton once on set early on in the franchise! Talk about tough parenting. 
When Alan Rockman was on set, it was hard to tell whether he was being himself or Snape and this terrified the children - with good reason! Unfortunately, after the Snape actor had warned the young performers to be careful around his cloak, one young Hogwarts student messed up, accidentally causing injury to Rickman and earning a place in his bad books. 
It’s not just actors that caused issues - the set and props caused their fair share of damage, giving actors allergic reactions, freezing the soles of feet, causing headaches, and putting them in precarious situations.
No matter the situation, the actors braved through and managed to make it to the end of filming fairly unharmed!

snippet.title: Harry Potter Actors Reveal Most Emotional Scenes To Film
snippet.description:
Throughout filming the epic Harry Potter franchise, a huge range of emotions was experienced and plenty of tears were shed. One scene Dan Radcliffe filmed was actually so hard to watch and listen to, that other cast members started crying - that’s powerful stuff! For one scene, Emma Watson went a bit too far with her acting chops and wept through an upsetting scene. The director actually had to pull her back and make sure the actress was alright after such an intense and moving performance. 
Saying goodbye is always hard - but it’s a particular kind of tricky when an actor is leaving a role they grew up with practically their whole lives. Wrapping certain scenes made for several emotional farewells. The final scene Rupert Grint and Emma Watson filmed together left both actors completely soaked and full of overwhelming feelings - a solid combo of the intense scene itself and knowing they were one step closer to saying goodbye to their characters forever - but luckily - it wasn’t the last time! The 20th-anniversary reunion special brought about a mix of feelings and memories from all the performers who got the chance to walk the halls of Hogwarts once again Reflecting back on such a special time and of course, the performers they’ve lost over the years, made for a complete tear-fest. Tissues were required. When Helena Bonham Carter met her end as Bellatrix Lestrange, she also happened to wrap up her time on set - so a double ending of course made for quite an overwhelming day.
No matter the day or the circumstance, these emotional moments were always met with support and care from the HP fam.

snippet.description:
Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe) and Ron Weasley (Rupert Grint) are trapped in the Malfoy Family's basement with Luna Lovegood (Evanna Lynch) while Bellatrix Lestrange (Helena Bonham Carter) tortures Hermione (Emma Watson) about The Sword Of Gryffindor. Harry uses his broken mirror shards to ask for help. Dobby (Toby Jones), now a free elf, then appears to help Harry, Ron, Luna, and Hermoine escape from Bellatrix and the Malfoys.

About Harry Potter And The Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010):
In the first part of the seventh and final adventure, Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on their perilous mission to track down and destroy the secret to Voldemort's immortality and destruction -- the Horcruxes. On their own, without the guidance of their professors or the protection of Dumbledore, the three friends must now rely on one another more than ever. But there are Dark Forces in their midst that threaten to tear them apart. Meanwhile, the wizarding world has become a dangerous place for all enemies of the Dark Lord. The long-feared war has begun and Voldemort's Death Eaters seize control of the Ministry of Magic and even Hogwarts, terrorizing and arresting anyone who might oppose them. But the one prize they still seek is the one most valuable to Voldemort: Harry Potter. The Chosen One has become the hunted one as the Death Eaters search for Harry with orders to bring him to Voldemort...alive. Harry's only hope is to find the Horcruxes before Voldemort finds him. But as he searches for clues, he uncovers an old and almost forgotten tale -- the legend of the Deathly Hallows. And if the legend turns out to be true, it could give Voldemort the ultimate power he seeks. Little does Harry know that his future has already been decided by his past when, on that fateful day, he became "the Boy Who Lived." No longer just a boy, Harry Potter is drawing ever closer to the task for which he has been preparing since the day he first stepped into Hogwarts: the ultimate battle with Voldemort.
